headline: Ten o'clock finds the glass.
body: Sun climbs the brick and stops at the first-floor sash, warming the dust on the ledge. A bicycle chain ticks once, then again, then is gone down the hill. The kettle has already been emptied; the next pot will wait until someone remembers.

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: minute hand on the baker's clock

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: oblique on the counter, not yet noon
